item.title: Judge rules to release bodycam video, photos from fed agents in Brighton Park shooting
item.description: A judge ruled to release body camera video of a shooting of a woman by federal agents in Chicago during Operation Midway Blitz.

item.title: Thieves burglarize Oak Lawn restaurant, owner says | Video
item.description: An Oak Lawn restaurant owner says he thought his manager was joking, when she said someone had broken into the business.

item.title: Man shot to death in Chatham home, Chicago police say
item.description: A man died after he was shot multiple times inside of a home Friday evening on the city's South Side, Chicago police said.

item.title: This year's Super Bowl commercials feature AI, weight-loss drugs and celebrities galore
item.description: As Super Bowl Sunday approaches, the battle off the field for advertisers to win over 120 million-plus viewers will be just as heated as the rivalry between the New England Patriots and Seattle Seahawks.

item.title: Gavin McKenna case: Felony charge dropped against top NHL prospect from Penn State
item.description: Penn State hockey star Gavin McKenna will have his felony aggravated assault charge dropped, the Centre County District Attorney's Office announced Friday.

item.title: Woman found shot to death in West Rogers Park home, Chicago police say
item.description: A woman was found shot to death at a North Side home on Friday morning, Chicago police said. The victim was apparently found during a well-being check that was requested by a high-ranking city official.

item.title: Fired Chicago-area Catholic schools teacher faces new child sexual abuse allegations
item.description: A lawsuit filed by the mother of a second grader at Queen of Martyrs School in Evergreen Park alleges 43-year-old Brett Smith groomed her second grade son and inappropriately touched him.

item.title: Former Joliet bishop Ronald Hicks installed as new archbishop of New York Archdiocese
item.description: Joliet Bishop Ronald Hicks became the new leader of the New York Archdiocese on Friday.

item.title: Chicago Auto Show 2026 at McCormick Place, Feb. 7-16: Hours, ticket prices and more
item.description: The Chicago Automobile Trade Association (CATA), producer of the Chicago Auto Show, released the dates and plans for the 2026 event, which will be held Feb. 7-16 at McCormick Place.

item.title: Man acquitted in Bovino murder-for-hire trial must be released or given bond hearing, judge orders
item.description: A federal judge said a Chicago carpenter cleared of accusations that he put a $10,000 bounty on the life of Border Patrol Cmdr. Greg Bovino must be released from custody or given a bond hearing.
